# Developer and agent resources

> Machine-readable interfaces for Touhidul Alam Seyam's public portfolio data.

- [OpenAPI](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/openapi.json): Typed read-only profile, project, and research endpoints.
- [MCP](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp): Streamable HTTP transport with three read-only tools.
- [MCP server card](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Server and tool metadata.
- [AI catalog](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Domain-level resource catalog.
- [Agent skill index](https://seyamalam.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Discoverable skill metadata.
